## Overview

This is the OfficeFloor/Spring "PetClinic-Evolve" sample. The single write endpoint under test is `POST /api/owners`, implemented as a YAML-defined pipeline of small function classes (OfficeFloor "sections"). DTOs (`OwnerDto`, `OwnerFieldsDto`, `OwnerPageDto`) are generated at build time from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` into `target/generated-sources/openapi/...`, not hand-written.

## 1. The POST /owners endpoint

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`

This YAML defines the full create pipeline (authorize `hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`, all steps `govern: [transaction]`). The step order relevant to your task:

`recall (RecallIdempotentOwner) -> validate (ValidateOwnerFields) -> ensureRegistrationDate -> ensurePostcode -> normalize (telephone) -> normalizeEmail -> ensureEmailNotDisposable -> normalizeAddress -> ensureCityCapacity -> ensureDailyLimit -> build (BuildOwner) -> assignHousehold -> ensureUniqueIdentity -> flagPossibleDuplicate -> resolveRegistrationDate -> assignCustomerCode (AssignOwnerCustomerCode) -> countNamesakes -> assignMembershipLevel (AssignMembershipLevel) -> save (SaveOwner) -> record (RecordIdempotentOwner) -> audit (AuditOwnerCreated) -> respond (RespondWithOwnerCreated)`

Function classes live in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`.

Key small classes (full content):

- `BuildOwner.java` — maps the validated `OwnerFieldsDto` request into an `Owner` via `OwnerMapper.toOwner(request)` and publishes it as `Out<Owner>`.
- `SaveOwner.java` — `ownerRepository.save(owner)` (this is where the id is assigned).
- `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` — builds the `OwnerDto` via `OwnerResponses.toDto(...)` and returns `ResponseEntity.created(URI "/api/owners/" + id).body(dto)`.
- `ValidateOwnerFields.java` — first step; reads `@RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto`, throws `MissingOwnerFieldsException` listing all blank required fields (firstName, lastName, address/addressLine1, city, telephone), else republishes the validated body.
- `OwnerResponses.java` — the single place that turns an `Owner` into an `OwnerDto` (also stamps `bulkSignupWarning`); shared by 201/200/idempotent-replay responses.

## 2. Audit logic (the "audit line")

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java` — this is the only audit emitter in main. It logs ONE line to a dedicated SLF4J logger named `"AUDIT"`:

```java
